note: Eldorado NF campground at 4,100 ft, with three loops under dense cedar and fir along the Middle Fork Cosumnes River. The river is stocked with rainbow trout, and a paved, accessible walkway runs just under a mile beside it past a riverside picnic area. Most parking aprons are paved. RVs may not fill from the campground taps. --Claude
summary: Pipi (Eldorado NF): creekside upgrade proposed (lidar: river 35-50 m from sites 016/017, ~15 m wide); $36 single/$72/$108; rec.gov some_sites 05-22..09-06, FCFS to 10-31; 2-night weekends; 51 sites, RVs to 35 ft; vault toilets + water; pin ~870 m off; phone and FS page changes.
flags: WATERFRONT UPGRADE not waterfront -> creekside (stored value is not --AWH). The Middle Fork Cosumnes is ~15 m wide here (under 30 m, so creekside). 3DEP lidar puts its channel 35-50 m from site 017 (38.566667,-120.434833; RV 35 ft) and 45-55 m from 016 (38.566716,-120.434487; RV 35 ft), 3.5-4.5 m below the pads over a gentle slope (~7 deg), which is an easy walk down. Both are reservable nightly sites. Imagery is canopy-blind here. Rec.gov's paved riverside walkway runs along the river. Proposed evidence: '3DEP lidar 2026-11-26: Middle Fork Cosumnes (~15 m wide) channel 35-50 m from sites 016/017, 3.5-4.5 m below over gentle ground; rec.gov paved river walkway.' If AWH prefers, the waterfront can stay down since the canopy hides the bank.
